d: In this episode of , we will discuss the growing tensions between the Samajwadi Party and Congress ahead 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. We will examine what transpired at yesterday’s meeting and why differences between the two allies have intensified over seat-sharing. Why did Akhilesh Yadav announce five candidates while negotiations were still underway? We will also discuss the speculation surrounding Congress MP Imran Masood and his role in the ongoing political developments.
